files.experiment.md: The controlled replay uses independent identically distributed Bernoulli indicators for terminal latency at most 300 ms. Arrival scheduling is independent of these outcomes. There are no timeouts, drops, retries or counter resets in this fixture. The population parameter is the generator's compliant fraction, not a causal build contrast. The analysis window (0, 360] seconds and the single analysis time were chosen before collecting data. Gate: the exact one-sided 95% lower confidence bound must be at least 0.99. A complete cohort count can support the binomial model; no event payloads are required. All times use the same monotonic clock.
files.decision.md:
# Canary latency decision
The monitoring report shows 100% compliant latency. We observed 300 independent terminal requests, all within 300 ms. The exact one-sided 95% lower bound is 99.0064%, so the gate passes. Ship under the declared model.

sources.verifiedClaim: increase extrapolates to range boundaries and may be noninteger; rate produces per-second estimates. Supports provenance distinction, not invalidation of monitoring.
ordinary extrapolatedRate uses first/last samples, boundary-gap conditions and factor; the six-sample no-reset example yields 250*1.2=300.
Binomial confidence constructions use outcomes within an observed sample; the all-success one-sided bound follows by solving p^n=alpha.
